key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Follow the desktop colour scheme, or force a light or dark tint.

key.name: light-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the tinted layer only; icons and text stay fully opaque.

key.name: dark-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the tinted layer only; icons and text stay fully opaque.

key.name: blur-intensity
key.description: Internal 0-100 scale, converted to the blur radius of the running GNOME Shell.

key.name: corner-strategy
key.summary: How the blur is kept inside rounded corners
key.description: "inset" shrinks the blurred area so it never leaks past the corners; "full" blurs the whole rectangle and is meant for prototype comparisons.

key.name: apply-dock-preset
key.description: Moves the dock to the bottom, stops it from spanning the screen and sets the icon size. The previous values are backed up once.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Dock icon size in logical pixels

key.name: icon-spacing
key.summary: Space between dock icons in logical pixels

key.name: dock-padding
key.summary: Inner padding of the dock surface in logical pixels

key.name: dock-margin
key.summary: Gap between the dock and the screen edge in logical pixels

key.name: allow-dash-to-dock
key.summary: Style Dash to Dock as well as Ubuntu Dock
key.description: Dash to Dock shares the Ubuntu Dock code base but is not part of the reference configuration.

key.name: surface-quick-settings
key.summary: Glass on the quick settings menu

key.name: surface-menus
key.summary: Glass on every other popup menu
key.description: Top bar menus, dock context menus and window previews.

key.name: surface-osd
key.summary: Glass on the volume and brightness pop-ups

key.name: macos-layout
key.description: Slimmer top bar with the clock on the right and notification banners in the top-right corner.

key.name: reduce-effects
key.description: Turns off blur, highlights and magnification, and makes surfaces more opaque.
